messages:
Jordan H: hey team :wave: I’m Jordan (joined today) — product designer on the growth squad. Quick access check: I signed up with my company email but I can’t open the Redwood Inference Figma org. says 'invite pending'. Anyone know the fastest path?
Aisha Malik: welcome Jordan!! :tada: we usually provision Figma via Okta group 'redwood-designers'. Lina handles the group invites, but sometimes contractors/early accounts miss the mapping. Tagging Lina.
Lina O: hi Jordan — I can push you an invite now. can you confirm the email you used? also are you internal or contractor?
Jordan H: thanks Lina — jordan.h@example.com. internal full-time.
Lina O: ok gave you an invite (just clicked send). you should get an email from figma@figma.com. If nothing shows up, try the direct org link after you sign in with SSO: https://www.figma.com/@redwood-inference.
Jordan H: got the invite and accepted, I can open the org but don’t have access to the Growth file sandbox or components library.
Aisha Malik: two things — 1) growth files are in a team space with editor perms gated, 2) shared component library is a separate project. I’ll add you to the Growth editors group.
Riley Chen: cc @Jordan H — for context on research assets, we keep templates + research roadmap in Notion under: https://redwood.notion.site/design-research (you'll need Notion access). If you want to get up to speed on current studies, see the 'qual + quant backlog' page.
Jordan H: awesome — I requested Notion access this morning via the onboarding checklist. If that isn’t approved, is there an alternate copy?
Riley Chen: I can share a sanitized export as a short-term measure. sending now.
DesignOps Bot: Lina O added Jordan H to Okta group 'redwood-designers' at 2026-03-23T15:02:37Z :lock:
Samir Patel: heads-up — sometimes invites from Figma land in promotions/spam for Gmail. also if you sign in with the wrong email (personal account) Figma will show invite pending on the wrong account.
Jordan H: that was me earlier lol — used personal one first. fixed now. Thanks for the tips.
Aisha Malik: for roadmap context, start with Product > Roadmap > Q2 Themes in Notion. Also open the 'Design handoff & infra' doc — it explains tokens/vars we use when creating component props for the runtime UI.
Jordan H: where do I find the handoff doc path?
Aisha Malik: Notion -> Product -> Design -> 'Handoff & Runtime Tokens' (direct link: https://redwood.notion.site/hand off-token-guide)
Jordan H: perfect, found it. quick question on process: if I need a small experiment deployed (UI only), who do I ask for a short stack review?
Samir Patel: ping eng-frontend for implementation questions, but for infra constraints (latency/cost) cc @Aisha or me. we usually do a 15-min async review on the PR.
Riley Chen: also loop me in if the experiment touches telemetry or research hooks — I can help define metrics and a short survey.
Jordan H: thanks — last onboarding thing: is there a weekly design guild or sync I should join?
Aisha Malik: yeah every Thu 10am PT 'Design Guild' (calendar invite is org-wide). I’ll add you.
DesignOps Bot: Aisha Malik invited Jordan H to "Design Guild" recurring event at 2026-03-23T15:10:04Z :calendar:
Jordan H: amazing, appreciate the rapid help everyone. one minor hiccup: Okta sent me two sessions and then Figma logged me out; if it happens to others might be an SSO mapping race. filing a quick note in #help if it recurs.
Lina O: noted — we had a short Okta sync earlier that may have caused duplicated sessions. monitoring.
Jordan H: last tiny thing — curious where the product/prioritization docs live (roadmap ownership, decision logs)? I can’t find ADRs in Notion.
Aisha Malik: decision logs are under Product -> Ops -> "Decisions & ADRs". If you don’t have access, ping me and I’ll share the relevant ones for Growth.
Jordan H: ok grabbed the ADRs and the growth epic list. thanks again :thumbsup:
Riley Chen: welcome aboard — I’ll DM to set up a 30-min intro so we can walk through research playbooks.
Jordan H: thanks Riley, looking forward to it!
